title: अष्टषष्ट्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: After Arjuna's words, none of the great chariot-warriors speaks. Arjuna rebukes Dhrishtadyumna for killing his teacher, and Satyaki angrily blames Arjuna, while Dhrishtadyumna defends himself.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಮಾತಿನ ನಂತರ ಮಹಾರಥರು ಮಾತನಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಗುರುವನ್ನು ಕೊಂದುದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಜುನ ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನನನ್ನು ಖಂಡಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಅರ್ಜುನನನ್ನು ದೂಷಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನ ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन की बात के बाद कोई महारथी नहीं बोलता। अर्जुन गुरु को मारने के लिए धृष्टद्युम्न को फटकारते हैं, सात्यकि क्रोध से अर्जुन को दोष देता है और धृष्टद्युम्न अपना बचाव करते हैं।
summary.te: అర్జునుని మాటల తరువాత మహారథులెవరూ మాట్లాడరు. గురువును చంపినందుకు అర్జునుడు ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుని నిందిస్తాడు; సాత్యకి కోపంతో అర్జునుని తప్పుపడతాడు; ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుడు తనను సమర్థించుకుంటాడు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனனின் சொற்களுக்குப்பின் பெருந்தேர்வீரர் யாரும் பேசவில்லை. குருவைக் கொன்றதற்காக அர்ஜுனன் த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னனைக் கடிய, சாத்யகி சினத்துடன் அர்ஜுனனைக் குறை கூற, த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னன் தன்னை நியாயப்படுத்துகிறான்.
summary.ml: അർജുനന്റെ വാക്കുകൾക്കുശേഷം മഹാരഥന്മാരിൽ ആരും സംസാരിക്കുന്നില്ല. ആചാര്യനെ കൊന്നതിന് അർജുനൻ ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നനെ ശാസിക്കുന്നു; കോപത്തോടെ സാത്യകി അർജുനനെ കുറ്റപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു, ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നൻ സ്വയം ന്യായീകരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.168; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

sections.title: नारायणास्त्रमोक्षपर्व
sections.titleEn: Narayanastramoksha Parva (Release of the Narayana weapon)

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नोचुस्तत्र महारथाः ।
अप्रियं वा प्रियं वापि महाराज धनंजयम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Arjuna's words, the great chariot-warriors there said nothing to Dhananjaya, O great king, neither pleasing nor displeasing.

verses.text:
ततः क्रुद्धो महाबाहुर्भीमसेनोऽभ्यभाषत ।
उत्स्मयन्निव कौन्तेयमर्जुनं भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty-armed Bhimasena, angry, spoke to Arjuna, son of Kunti, O best of Bharatas, almost with a mocking smile.

verses.text:
मुनिर्यथारण्यगतो भाषसे धर्मसंहितम् ।
न्यस्तदण्डो यथा पार्थ ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः ॥

meaning.en: Bhima said: You speak words of dharma like a sage who has gone to the forest, like a brahmin of strict vows who has laid down the rod, Partha.

verses.text:
क्षतात्त्राता क्षताज्जीवन्क्षान्तस्त्रिष्वपि साधुषु ।
क्षत्रियः क्षितिमाप्नोति क्षिप्रं धर्मं यशः श्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: A kshatriya protects from injury, lives by injury, and is forbearing toward the good in all three ways; thus he quickly gains the earth, dharma, fame and fortune.

verses.text:
स भवान्क्षत्रियगुणैर्युक्तः सर्वैः कुलोद्वहः ।
अविपश्चिद्यथा वाक्यं व्याहरन्नाद्य शोभसे ॥

meaning.en: You, the upholder of the family, who have all the kshatriya virtues, do not look fitting today, speaking like one who has no understanding.

verses.text:
पराक्रमस्ते कौन्तेय शक्रस्येव शचीपतेः ।
न चातिवर्तसे धर्मं वेलामिव महोदधिः ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, your valour is like that of Shakra, husband of Shachi, and you do not cross the bounds of dharma, as the great ocean does not cross its shore.

verses.text:
न पूजयेत्त्वा कोऽन्वद्य यत्त्रयोदशवार्षिकम् ।
अमर्षं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा धर्ममेवाभिकाङ्क्षसे ॥

meaning.en: Who would not honour you today, who for thirteen years kept your anger behind you and desired only dharma?

verses.text:
दिष्ट्या तात मनस्तेऽद्य स्वधर्ममनुवर्तते ।
आनृशंस्ये च ते दिष्ट्या बुद्धिः सततमच्युत ॥

meaning.en: By good fortune, dear brother, your mind follows your own duty today, and by good fortune, unfailing one, your thought is constantly on compassion.

verses.text:
यत्तु धर्मप्रवृत्तस्य हृतं राज्यमधर्मतः ।
द्रौपदी च परामृष्टा सभामानीय शत्रुभिः ॥

meaning.en: But when, though we acted righteously, our kingdom was taken unjustly, and Draupadi was dragged into the assembly and handled by our enemies,

verses.text:
वनं प्रव्राजिताश्चास्म वल्कलाजिनवाससः ।
अनर्हमाणास्तं भावं त्रयोदश समाः परैः ॥

meaning.en: and we were sent into the forest, clad in bark and deerskin, for thirteen years, not deserving such treatment from our foes,

verses.text:
एतान्यमर्षस्थानानि मर्षितानि त्वयानघ ।
क्षत्रधर्मप्रसक्तेन सर्वमेतदनुष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: these causes of anger, faultless one, you endured, and all this was done while you were set on the kshatriya duty.

verses.text:
तमधर्ममपाक्रष्टुमारब्धः सहितस्त्वया ।
सानुबन्धान्हनिष्यामि क्षुद्रान्राज्यहरानहम् ॥

meaning.en: Together with you I began to cast out that unrighteousness; I shall kill those mean seizers of the kingdom with all their kin.

verses.text:
त्वया तु कथितं पूर्वं युद्धायाभ्यागता वयम् ।
घटामश्च यथाशक्ति त्वं तु नोऽद्य जुगुप्ससे ॥

meaning.en: You yourself said before that we had come for battle, and we have tried as far as we could; yet now you condemn us.

verses.text:
स्वधर्मं नेच्छसे ज्ञातुं मिथ्या वचनमेव ते ।
भयार्दितानामस्माकं वाचा मर्माणि कृन्तसि ॥

meaning.en: You do not wish to know your own duty, and your words are false; you cut at the vitals of us, who are already afflicted by fear, with your speech.

verses.text:
वपन्व्रणे क्षारमिव क्षतानां शत्रुकर्शन ।
विदीर्यते मे हृदयं त्वया वाक्शल्यपीडितम् ॥

meaning.en: O tormentor of foes, you are like one pouring caustic on wounds; my heart is torn, pierced by the arrows of your words.

verses.text:
अधर्ममेतद्विपुलं धार्मिकः सन्न बुध्यसे ।
यत्त्वमात्मानमस्मांश्च प्रशंस्यान्न प्रशंससि ।
यः कलां षोडशीं त्वत्तो नार्हते तं प्रशंससि ॥

meaning.en: You are righteous but do not see this great wrong, that you do not praise yourself and us who deserve praise, and praise one who is not worth a sixteenth part of you.

verses.text:
स्वयमेवात्मनो वक्तुं न युक्तं गुणसंस्तवम् ।
दारयेयं महीं क्रोधाद्विकिरेयं च पर्वतान् ॥

meaning.en: It is not fitting to sing one's own virtues, yet in my anger I could split the earth and scatter the mountains.

verses.text:
आविध्य च गदां गुर्वीं भीमां काञ्चनमालिनीम् ।
गिरिप्रकाशान्क्षितिजान्भञ्जेयमनिलो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Whirling my heavy, terrible mace wreathed in gold, I could break mountain-like trees as the wind does.

verses.text:
स त्वमेवंविधं जानन्भ्रातरं मां नरर्षभ ।
द्रोणपुत्राद्भयं कर्तुं नार्हस्यमितविक्रम ॥

meaning.en: Knowing that I, your brother, am such a man, bull among men, you of immeasurable valour should not fear Drona's son.

verses.text:
अथ वा तिष्ठ बीभत्सो सह सर्वैर्नरर्षभैः ।
अहमेनं गदापाणिर्जेष्याम्येको महाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Or else stay here, Bibhatsu, with all the bulls among men; mace in hand, I alone will defeat him in the great battle.

verses.text:
ततः पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रः पार्थमथाब्रवीत् ।
संक्रुद्धमिव नर्दन्तं हिरण्यकशिपुं हरिः ॥

meaning.en: Then the son of the Panchala king spoke to Partha, as Hari spoke to the furious, roaring Hiranyakashipu.

verses.text:
बीभत्सो विप्रकर्माणि विदितानि मनीषिणाम् ।
याजनाध्यापने दानं तथा यज्ञप्रतिग्रहौ ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna said: Bibhatsu, the wise know the brahmin's duties: performing sacrifices, teaching, giving, sacrificing and receiving gifts.

verses.text:
षष्ठमध्ययनं नाम तेषां कस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितः ।
हतो द्रोणो मया यत्तत्किं मां पार्थ विगर्हसे ॥

meaning.en: The sixth is studying; in which of these was Drona established? Since I killed Drona, why do you blame me, Partha?

verses.text:
अपक्रान्तः स्वधर्माच्च क्षत्रधर्ममुपाश्रितः ।
अमानुषेण हन्त्यस्मानस्त्रेण क्षुद्रकर्मकृत् ॥

meaning.en: He fell away from his own duty and took up the kshatriya's, and that doer of base deeds kills us with a superhuman weapon.

verses.text:
तथा मायां प्रयुञ्जानमसह्यं ब्राह्मणब्रुवम् ।
माययैव निहन्याद्यो न युक्तं पार्थ तत्र किम् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever would use illusion, unbearable as it is, against a pretend-brahmin using illusion, is not at fault; what is wrong there, Partha?

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तथा मया शस्ते यदि द्रौणायनी रुषा ।
कुरुते भैरवं नादं तत्र किं मम हीयते ॥

meaning.en: If in rage Drona's son makes a dreadful roar because I killed him so, what do I lose by it?

verses.text:
न चाद्भुतमिदं मन्ये यद्द्रौणिः शुद्धगर्जया ।
घातयिष्यति कौरव्यान्परित्रातुमशक्नुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Nor do I find it strange that Drona's son, unable to protect the Kauravas, will have them slain by mere empty roaring.

verses.text:
यच्च मां धार्मिको भूत्वा ब्रवीषि गुरुघातिनम् ।
तदर्थमहमुत्पन्नः पाञ्चाल्यस्य सुतोऽनलात् ॥

meaning.en: And that you, being righteous, call me a killer of my teacher: it was for that very purpose that I was born from the fire as the Panchala's son.

verses.text:
यस्य कार्यमकार्यं वा युध्यतः स्यात्समं रणे ।
तं कथं ब्राह्मणं ब्रूयाः क्षत्रियं वा धनंजय ॥

meaning.en: Whether for one who fights in battle his act is right or wrong makes no difference to him, how can you call him a brahmin or a kshatriya, Dhananjaya?

verses.text:
यो ह्यनस्त्रविदो हन्याद्ब्रह्मास्त्रैः क्रोधमूर्छितः ।
सर्वोपायैर्न स कथं वध्यः पुरुषसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Best of men, how should one not be killed by every means who, maddened by anger, kills those ignorant of weapons with brahma weapons?

verses.text:
विधर्मिणं धर्मविद्भिः प्रोक्तं तेषां विषोपमम् ।
जानन्धर्मार्थतत्त्वज्ञः किमर्जुन विगर्हसे ॥

meaning.en: Those who know dharma have spoken of an unrighteous man as being like poison to them; knowing the truth of dharma and profit, Arjuna, why do you blame me?

verses.text:
नृशंसः स मयाक्रम्य रथ एव निपातितः ।
तन्माभिनन्द्यं बीभत्सो किमर्थं नाभिनन्दसे ॥

meaning.en: I attacked that cruel one and felled him right in his chariot; so you should congratulate me, Bibhatsu. Why do you not?

verses.text:
कृते रणे कथं पार्थ ज्वलनार्कविषोपमम् ।
भीमं द्रोणशिरश्छेदे प्रशस्यं न प्रशंससि ॥

meaning.en: Partha, why do you not praise the terrible deed in the battle, the cutting off of Drona's head, which was like fire, sun and poison, and so worthy of praise?

verses.text:
योऽसौ ममैव नान्यस्य बान्धवान्युधि जघ्निवान् ।
छित्त्वापि तस्य मूर्धानं नैवास्मि विगतज्वरः ॥

meaning.en: He who killed my kinsmen in battle, mine and no one else's, even after cutting off his head I am not free of my fever.

verses.text:
तच्च मे कृन्तते मर्म यन्न तस्य शिरो मया ।
निषादविषये क्षिप्तं जयद्रथशिरो यथा ॥

meaning.en: And this pierces my vitals, that I did not throw his head into the land of the Nishadas, as was done with Jayadratha's head.

verses.text:
अवधश्चापि शत्रूणामधर्मः शिष्यतेऽर्जुन ।
क्षत्रियस्य ह्ययं धर्मो हन्याद्धन्येत वा पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Not killing enemies is also contrary to dharma, Arjuna; for this is the kshatriya's duty, to kill or be killed.

verses.text:
स शत्रुर्निहतः संख्ये मया धर्मेण पाण्डव ।
यथा त्वया हतः शूरो भगदत्तः पितुः सखा ॥

meaning.en: That enemy was slain by me in battle lawfully, Pandava, as you killed the hero Bhagadatta, your father's friend.

verses.text:
पितामहं रणे हत्वा मन्यसे धर्ममात्मनः ।
मया शत्रौ हते कस्मात्पापे धर्मं न मन्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Having killed your grandfather in battle you think yourself righteous; when I killed an enemy, why do you not think it righteous, you sinful man?

verses.text:
नानृतः पाण्डवो ज्येष्ठो नाहं वाधार्मिकोऽर्जुन ।
शिष्यध्रुङ्निहतः पापो युध्यस्व विजयस्तव ॥

meaning.en: The eldest Pandava did not lie, nor am I unrighteous, Arjuna; the sinner, a betrayer of his pupil, has been killed. Now fight, and may you have victory.
